market.basis: heading names the legacy county (Fairfield County); planning-region composition is an approximation

ct.basis_planning: approximation from the nine planning regions; a town-level crosswalk is needed for exactness
ct.fit_legacy: exact: the market is Fairfield County
ct.fit_planning: approximate: Fairfield County towns fall in Greater Bridgeport and Western Connecticut, except Shelton (Naugatuck Valley), and Western Connecticut also takes some Litchfield County towns

market.reason: Legacy county is exact; the two planning regions that cover most of its towns are only an approximation.
